drawPrimitives._doc: the RandUtilDrawRecorder logs each draw {seq, method, args, result, consumed, stateIdxBefore, bufferIdxBefore}. consumed=false marks a nextBool short-circuit (prob>=1 / prob<=0) that makes NO draw — the cursor is unchanged (the load-bearing parity trap). The Kotlin LiteHashDrbg exposes the SAME stateIdx(Long)+bufferIdx(Int) byte fingerprint; the replay asserts value-for-value AND cursor-for-cursor at the FIRST divergent draw.
drawPrimitives.cursorFields: LiteHashDRBG protected int stateIdx (SHA-512 block counter) + protected int bufferIdx (byte offset in the 64-byte block) — read via reflection, observe-only.
